name: camera-obstructed
description: Dome camera whose view is blocked by a hanging sign.

candidateControls.title: Entrance identification coverage
candidateControls.objective: Cameras covering entrances capture an unobstructed view adequate for identification.

candidateControls.title: Perimeter and parking camera coverage
candidateControls.objective: Cameras cover the perimeter and parking areas with unobstructed fields of view.

condition.summary: Dome camera intact; a hanging sign blocks most of its field of view toward the entrance.

deficiencies.description: Hanging sign obstructs the camera view of the entrance.

controls.rationale: Entrance camera view is visible and obstructed.

draftFindings.title: Entrance camera view obstructed by sign
draftFindings.description: A suspended sign sits directly in front of the dome camera covering the main entrance.
draftFindings.recommendation: Relocate the sign or the camera and verify the recorded view.

cautions: Confirm the recorded image; the obstruction is judged from the photo angle only.
